surface._doc: Local-processing attestation: the surface is the in-process HF transformers adapter (no third-party inference API, no retaining/logging surface); corpus-derived prompts are only ever submitted to this in-process surface, locally or inside the owner's gate job.

corpus._doc: Protected-corpus shards, mounted read-only; data-access contract: environment paths only, nothing copied into any repo.

verbatim._doc: Floor fixed by the underlying license agreement; only tighten.

mia._doc: Method of record: reference-calibrated loss difference (LiRA-style). Gated statistics are the calibrated ones; naive statistics are preserved in the metrics for disclosure. Reference self control must sit at chance or the probe FAILs as broken. The reference must be DOMAIN-MATCHED: the candidate's own pre-adaptation init (same tokenizer, same eval config, verified never trained on the protected corpus). In remote gate jobs the reference path arrives via CLAUSE16E_REFERENCE_MODEL_PATH, resolved by the GATE_REFERENCE_HUB / GATE_REFERENCE_PATH / GATE_REFERENCE_SUBPATH precedence (HUB > PATH > SUBPATH). For the matched-split method of record see example-matched-split.json.

params.arch_note: the candidate's pre-adaptation base checkpoint (same tokenizer, same eval config, never trained on the protected corpus)

extraction._doc: Defaults ship generic + corpus-prefix templates; add synthetic canaries if the training run embedded any.

wordnet._doc: Reference-resource synset file (JSONL: id, pos, gloss, example, lemma[, relations]); vocab scan is the authoritative check, embedding sub-probe off.
